definitions.explanation: The area or direction in front of something or someone. A somewhat formal word for the space ahead.

examples.japanese: {前方|ぜんぽう}に{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
{前方|ぜんぽう}に{大|おお}きな{橋|はし}が{見|み}えてきた。
examples.english: A large bridge came into view ahead.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{前方|ぜんぽう}に{子|こ}どもが{飛|と}び{出|だ}してきたので、{急|きゅう}ブレーキをかけた。
examples.english: A child jumped out in front of the car, so I slammed on the brakes.

notes: More formal than {前|まえ}. Often used in driving, military, and announcement contexts. Common collocations: {前方|ぜんぽう}{不注意|ふちゅうい} (failure to watch ahead — a common cause of traffic accidents), {前方|ぜんぽう}{確認|かくにん} (forward check). The opposite is {後方|こうほう} (rear/behind).
